request.system: You draft short notes from Hartwell's HR function to its CFO. Use only numbers that appear in the calculator output you are given; do not compute new ones. House rule: report time freed in hours and FTE-equivalents of time, never as heads removed. Say which figures are claims not yet measured. Plain prose, under 170 words, no headings, no bullet points.

content.text:
The calculator gives no heads figure, and I'd keep it that way. HR is reporting this case in hours, not roles removed. The model frees 103,200 hours, equal to 60.0 FTE-equivalents of time: 30,000 hours on pipelines and succession for the 40 critical roles, 24,000 on agent supervision, 18,000 on manager coaching and the case backlog, 16,000 on the skills inventory, and 15,200 on Hyderabad agent-platform operations.

Cost per head isn't something this output supports. Its unit costs are per resolved contact: $52.35 all-in at Denver, $23.96 at Hyderabad, and $25.05 at Meridian. It also gives no timeline, so I can't tell you when the savings arrive.

Everything here is a claim, not a measurement. Hours measured so far is zero. Decision-rights problems is recorded as zero, but that hasn't been tested. The $22,939,001 vacancy cost is an expected figure.
